news.title: Nace AI Open-Sources Drex Max v1: A 27B Decision Model That Runs Locally on Apple Silicon
news.summary: Nace AI open-sources Drex Max v1, a 27B multimodal decision model scoring 67.52 that runs on Apple Silicon. The post Nace AI Open-Sources Drex Max v1: A 27B Decision Model That Runs Locally on Apple Silicon appeared first on MarkTechPost.

news.title: DeepSeek Open-Sources dsh-superagent, a Router-Worker Coding Agent
news.summary: DeepSeek released dsh-superagent, an MIT-licensed research prototype that turns GitHub and Feishu requests into parallel worker sessions. In DeepSeek’s own simulation, p95 task completion fell to 15.7 minutes from 29.5 minutes. The post DeepSeek Open-Sources dsh-superagent, a Router-Worker Coding Agent appeared first on MarkTechPost.
